title: ProcessingActivationDecision
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.dataprotection.ProcessingActivationDecision). A processing activity does not become active because a DPIA was approved; it becomes active because somebody with authority decided so and that decision was recorded with a reason code. Blocked and revoked activations are recorded through the same object, so a refusal is visible rather than silent. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
